# Exclusion receipt

*Generated by `src/derive_exclusion_codes.py`. Regenerate; do not hand-edit.*

The private token list is not in this repository. Its SHA-256 at the time
the code set was derived:

    2ff61f4fa98949402bd9b96126d972685b03217b4ce71e5dfb3a71e2e6f69a7f

Eleven count queries against openFDA firm fields produced the excluded
product-code set in `data/reference/excluded_product_codes.csv`
(671 codes). Query text is not recorded because it carries the tokens;
each query is identified by a label only. The MAUDE query is capped at
100 buckets without an API key, so the set is a lower bound on that
endpoint and the cohort check below does not rely on it alone.

| Query | Product codes returned | Records behind them | HTTP |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| EX-01 510k applicant, primary term | 184 | 882 | 200 |
| EX-02 510k applicant, related phrases | 289 | 1,991 | 200 |
| EX-03 pma applicant, primary term | 8 | 129 | 200 |
| EX-04 pma applicant, related phrases | 11 | 251 | 200 |
| EX-05 recall recalling_firm, primary term | 193 | 2,149 | 200 |
| EX-06 recall recalling_firm, related phrases | 152 | 1,319 | 200 |
| EX-07 registrationlisting registration.name, primary term | 389 | 3,432 | 200 |
| EX-08 registrationlisting owner_operator.firm_name, primary term | 442 | 5,079 | 200 |
| EX-09 registrationlisting registration.name, related phrases | 342 | 3,253 | 200 |
| EX-10 registrationlisting owner_operator.firm_name, related phrases | 134 | 969 | 200 |
| EX-11 event manufacturer_d_name, primary term (100-bucket cap) | 100 | 254,813 | 200 |
